summary.text: Angela Stiens is a Republican state representative who has represented Kansas House District 39 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026. An occupational therapy practitioner, she was a Shawnee city councilwoman as of her 2024 campaign.

paragraphs.text: Stiens' career experience includes working as an occupational therapy practitioner, and Ballotpedia reports that during her 2024 campaign she was serving as a Shawnee city councilwoman.
Stiens took office in the Kansas House on January 13, 2025, succeeding Representative Owen Donohoe.

During the 2025-2026 session she served on the Health and Human Services, Social Services Budget, and Pensions, Investments and Benefits committees, and as vice chair of the Financial Institutions and Pensions Committee.
